tripRule: Trips are as reported in the covering email, which supersedes the workbook derivation.
movementRule: One movement is one transfer between locations: port to rig, rig to port, or rig to rig. Repositioning at the rig already occupied does not count, nor does a shift between two port-side locations.

trucks.rule: Count truck and pickup units per movement. A dispatch counts as out, an arrival counts as in. An offload of a unit already counted on arrival is not a second movement, and a duplicated row sharing a delivery ticket is counted once.

dataNotes: Vessel trips: email 15, not re-derivable from the Vessel sheet. The email reports CA1 3, CA3 1, CA5 2, Charlie-3 9. The Vessel sheet shows Charlie-3 casting off from berth 4 six times. The email's figures are used, per the standing rule.
Well name: SH-0001 or SHU-0001. The 08.10 email and Vessel E4 say SHU-0001. The 01.10 email, Port E61 ("Well# SH-0001") and every call-off (OD-SH1-...) say SH-0001.

Pipe yard to berth 20 truck moves are counted unevenly. The rule counts a line phrased as a dispatch or an arrival, so E79 and E80 (four trucks from the Shuaiba Port pipe yard) and E49 (a truck dispatched to the pipe yard) are counted, while E75 and E87 (four trucks each, phrased as loading at the pipe yard) are not. Excluding every move inside the port gives 74 truck moves; this report shows 79. Confirm whether internal pipe yard moves should count.
Charlie-3 on 04.10: fuel or fresh water. Port E40 records 20 m³ of fuel; Vessel E19 records 20 m³ of fresh water. Read as fuel. The total is unchanged either way.
Port E88 names two vessels for the same cement. "From Vessel Crest Argus-5" and "47MT ... from Vessel CA-1". Vessel E30 records CA5 discharging cement. Not in the cubic-metre totals.
Port E29 repeats E28 word for word, including ticket BAR-DT-06. Counted once. If they were two trucks, inbound moves are 54, not 53.
Port E50 (05.10) repeats E43 (04.10) word for word, including ticket CMT-OD-SH1-B-1-8. Counted once, on 04.10.
COSL-DT-OD-SH1-B-1-3C is used twice on 01.10. Port E10 (60 drill pipes) and E12 (2 lifts) carry the same ticket with different cargo. Counted as two trucks.
The 01.10 summary lines disagree with the detail. E16 and E17 say 2 trucks of lifts and 6 of drill pipe; the detail lines E7 to E14 show 4 and 4. The total, 8, agrees.
headline: OD1 arrived at the new well location SHU-0001 and is spotting and building up the 21-1/4" BOP. OPH remains off hired.

dailyOperations.label: Wed 07 Oct 2026
dailyOperations.source: Daily Ground Operations, as circulated in the 08.10.2026 email
lines: One pickup dispatched to Bureau Veritas, Shuwaikh, with six lifts of water samples received from the OD1 and OPH locations, per delivery ticket RM-SP-9048.
Three trucks arrived from the Shuaiba Port pipe yard with three joints each of 36" R3 casing for OD1 (call-off OD-SH1-B-3-1), per delivery ticket HPM-DT-1599.
One truck arrived from the Shuaiba Port pipe yard with three joints of 36" R3 casing for OD1 (call-off OD-SH1-B-3-1), per delivery ticket HPM-DT-1598.
One truck arrived from NOV Ahmadi with two 6-1/2" drilling jars for OD1 (call-off OD-SH1-A-1-17), per delivery ticket HPM-DT-1600.
Two call-off trucks arrived from a KOC facility with a KOC centralizer, redress kit, swell packer and compound for OD1 (call-off OD-SH1-B-3-1), per delivery ticket HPM-DT-1601.
One truck arrived from COSL Mina Abdallah with two lifts for OD1 (call-off OD-SH1-B-6-3), per delivery ticket COSL-DT-OD-SH1-B-6-3.
One truck arrived at the Shuaiba Port pipe yard from the CAT Jahra yard with a CAT power generator.
Seven trucks arrived and were offloaded with 35 joints of 30" R3 casing, 234.51 ppf (CAT ID 70126882).
One truck arrived and was offloaded with 5 joints of 30" R3 casing, 196.26 ppf (CAT ID 701268875).
Slinging of 36" and 38" R-2 and R-3 casing joints started at the pipe yard; 11 joints loaded on four regular trucks to move them to Shuaiba berth 20.
The cementing team arrived at Shuaiba Port to transfer bulk cement from vessel Crest Argus-5 to the port silos; 47 MT of cement transferred to the port silos from vessel CA-1.
Fuel transferred to shore base equipment.
Al Mansoori completed inspection of 20 joints of 30" R3 casing, 234.51 ppf (CAT ID 70126882).
The rest of the 36" R3 casing, with a 36" float shoe, a 36" float collar, a 38" × 36" landing joint and two 36" × 36" crossovers, transferred from the pipe yard to berth 20, per DT-HPM-1601.
Charlie-3 sailed to OD1 with the COSL BOP frame, per manifest CM-OD-1014.
Loading of 36" and 38" casing on CA5 continuing.
